operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Item (1) rewrites Sec. 2 of EO 11659 (jurisdiction), extending the commission's jurisdiction to North Dakota and to the Souris, Red and Rainy River drainage basins. EO 11737 (signed 1973-09-07) has no effective-date wording for Sec. 1, so its amendments took effect on signing. No later order amended the text this item placed in EO 11659: the later amendments of EO 11659 (EO 11882 sec. 2(d), 1975-10-06, and EO 12038 sec. 4(a)(5)(v), effective as of 1977-10-01, on the Atomic Energy Commission / ERDA / Department of Energy entry, and EO 12148 sec. 5-213(f), 1979-07-20, adding the Federal Emergency Management Agency) all touch only Sec. 3(2), the federal member list, which this order did not amend. The new Sec. 2 therefore governed the commission until it terminated on 1981-12-31.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Item (2) rewrites Sec. 3(3) of EO 11659 (State members) to add North Dakota. EO 11737 (signed 1973-09-07) has no effective-date wording for Sec. 1, so its amendments took effect on signing. No later order amended the text this item placed in EO 11659: the later amendments of EO 11659 (EO 11882 sec. 2(d), 1975-10-06, and EO 12038 sec. 4(a)(5)(v), effective as of 1977-10-01, on the Atomic Energy Commission / ERDA / Department of Energy entry, and EO 12148 sec. 5-213(f), 1979-07-20, adding the Federal Emergency Management Agency) all touch only Sec. 3(2), the federal member list, which this order did not amend. research_rationale: EO 11737 (signed 1973-09-07, 38 FR 24883-24884), read in full from the held official FR text, enlarges the Upper Mississippi River Basin Commission: Sec. 1 amends EO 11659 (new Secs. 2, 3(3) and 5, a new Sec. 6 and redesignation of Sec. 6 as Sec. 7); Sec. 2 transfers the terminated Souris-Red-Rainy commission's assets and obligations to it; Sec. 3 supersedes EO 11359 and EO 11635. The Sec. 1 text was never amended by a later order (later amendments of EO 11659 by EO 11882, 12038 and 12148 touch only Sec. 3(2)) and ended when EO 12319 sec. 1(f) terminated the commission on December 31, 1981, which is the whole-order end; EO 12319 sec. 5(b) then revoked EO 11659 'as amended' effective January 1, 1982, attached as a later event. Secs. 2 and 3 are one-time commands completed on taking effect on 1973-09-07. savings_residuals.reason: EO 11737 has no savings wording of its own. Its Sec. 2 moved the Souris-Red-Rainy commission's funds, property, records, employees, assets and obligations into the Upper Mississippi River Basin Commission, so those items became that commission's assets and obligations. On the commission's termination, EO 12319 (official FR, page-checked) sec. 2 provides for an orderly close-out with optional transition of commission activities to the member States, and sec. 3 directs that commission assets the Federal Government might otherwise claim be transferred to the member States (or entities they designate), subject to OMB approval of the terms. The residual assets are therefore transferred, not continued under this order; nothing of EO 11737 remains operative.
